theorem_N2.statement: For any finite class and any interface, two zero-error learners at equal information and equal oracle access answer the same coordinates (fibre criterion); if the comparator ranges over the same resource class it may be the procedure-learner itself, so PASS/FAIL separation is unreachable; if it ranges over a proper sub-class, the test measures the restriction.
parents: Mitchell 1980, The need for biases in learning generalizations

conditions.state: STATABLE; under it the arms coincide up to bias
NO_MARGIN_FOR_THE_SEPARATION; margin 1 for the restricted-comparator frontier
PLANTABLE (S1 laundering, S3 closure); not the blocker

freezable_only_as.restriction: behaviour-first ordering: the comparator determines the concept before any liveness query
